cover_headline: Supreme Court to Decide Whether Trump Can Bar Asylum Claims at Southern Border
facts: Two lower courts held the categorical asylum ban unlawful
A ruling is due by the end of June
The ban does not change H-1B, F-1 or green-card processing

end.headline: Supreme Court to Decide Whether Trump Can Bar Asylum Claims at Southern Border
end.line: The justices took up the administration's appeal after two lower courts held the categorical asylum ban unlawful, with a ruling due by the end of June.
